market_question: Will New People (NL) gain the most seats in the next Russian parliamentary election?
reasoning: The market implies a 28.2% chance that New People will make the largest net seat gain, but Russian elections are tightly controlled with United Russia dominating. New People won only 13 seats in 2021 and is unlikely to outperform a reshuffled dominance where United Russia or a regime-sponsored party records the largest gain. The true probability of an upstart outgaining all managed parties is very low, around 5%.
evidence_points: In 2021, New People won 13 seats (5.32% vote), far behind United Russia’s 324.
Russian parliamentary elections are engineered; the Kremlin ensures no party gains enough momentum to rival United Russia’s seat tally or net gain.
With repression and electoral manipulation increasing, the largest seat increase will likely be orchestrated for United Russia or a controlled successor, not an untrusted newcomer.
sources_consulted: 2021 Russian legislative election results (Wikipedia, OSCE reports)
General analysis of Russian electoral authoritarianism (Freedom House, academic sources)
